name: Turība University
summary: Riga business university with five English-taught professional bachelor's (business, logistics, communication, tourism, computer systems).

ib.text: No IB-specific page: send your secondary certificate (60% minimum on the last qualification) and pass an English test, a Maths test for Computer Systems or a Social Science test, and an online interview.

programmes.name: Computer Systems
programmes.about: Software engineering, computer architecture, system analysis and databases, built on ACM curriculum standards, with internships at IT companies; leads to the qualification Software Engineer.
programmes.selectionNote: Online English test (unless you hold a listed B2 certificate), a Maths test, then an online interview. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Hands-on business degree with about 60% practical study, business-plan work and a business incubator; leads to the qualification Company Manager.
programmes.selectionNote: Online English test (unless you hold a listed B2 certificate), a Social Science test, then an online interview. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business Logistics Management
programmes.about: Logistics and supply-chain management taught for newcomers and professionals alike, awarded as a professional bachelor's in business administration with the qualification Company Manager.
programmes.selectionNote: Online English test (unless you hold a listed B2 certificate), a Social Science test, then an online interview. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: International Communication Management
programmes.about: International project management, integrated marketing communication, crisis communication, international law and public speaking, with internships at institutions such as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
programmes.selectionNote: Online English test (unless you hold a listed B2 certificate), a Social Science test, then an online interview. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism and Hospitality Management
programmes.about: Management of tourism and hospitality services with internships at Latvian and foreign companies; the programme holds UNWTO TedQual accreditation and leads to the qualification Tourism Services Manager.
programmes.selectionNote: Online English test (unless you hold a listed B2 certificate), a Social Science test, then an online interview. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU/EEA citizens pay 2,990 euro a year (2,550 for Computer Systems) against 3,990 for other nationalities, and can pay in two or more instalments.
The 250 euro application fee is paid only after you pass the entrance test or tests.
Even with English-medium schooling you sit Turība's English test unless you hold one of its listed B2 certificates.
